limits: These are CPU fixture measurements, not GPU or general rendering speedups.

Native, field, typed, nested, named, role and method each include their complete operation; prepared_role excludes lookup and retains one borrow, while prepared_projection excludes adapter lookup but checks every receiver.

Generated monomorphic Describe::type_shape caches the canonical handle in a static LazyLock; these ValueMut fixtures measure that path. Generic Describe and direct Type::of use the TypeId registry. Typed native field paths do not require runtime discovery.
No speedup is inferred from older quick runs or the historical capability/table implementation.
Whole-frame allocation counts include profiler histogram growth and application frame construction, not just selector loans.
Zero warm allocations applies only to the measured operations and inline requirement sizes; callbacks and spilled rule storage can allocate.
Cold legacy metadata allocation samples in the reflection log are not measurements of the new structural type-slot runtime.

targeted_layout_repeat.interpretation: The native-versus-legacy ordering reverses in this same-binary repeat. The loaded-host runs do not establish a stable relative layout ranking.
